infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Bonfyr uses your contacts to find friends already on the app and invite others. Contact data stays on your device except for phone hashes used to match registered users.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Bonfyr uses your location only when you choose to share a meetup spot with a Spark.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Bonfyr needs photo library access so you can set a profile picture, choose a Crew photo, and post photos or short videos to keep a fire lit.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Bonfyr can use the camera when you take a photo or video for your profile or Crew.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Bonfyr needs the microphone when you record a video to post.

plugins.contactsPermission: Bonfyr uses contacts to find friends and send invites.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Bonfyr uses your location when you choose to share a meetup spot with a Spark.

plugins.photosPermission: Bonfyr needs photo library access so you can set a profile picture, choose a Crew photo, and post photos or short videos to keep a fire lit.
plugins.cameraPermission: Bonfyr uses the camera so you can take a photo for your profile, a Crew, chat, or a fire without leaving the app.
